agents.note: One OpenAI Agents SDK agent is constructed per run_agent invocation.

mcp.note: get_context7_mcp_server defines an @latest stdio MCP constructor, but get_all_mcp_servers returns an empty list so run_agent receives no active MCP servers.

authority.fact: Discord message content and attachments reach the agent as untrusted input.
The agent can ingest model-selected GitHub repository URLs and crawl/scrape model-selected web URLs.
No MCP server is effective in the reviewed runtime path because get_all_mcp_servers returns [].

policy_expectations.reason: Model-selected URL arguments reach GitHub/Tavily network tools without a repository-level destination allowlist.
Crawl/scrape capability accepts arbitrary URL destinations.

forbidden_expectations.reason: The @upstash/context7-mcp@latest constructor is not activated or bound into the effective agent runtime.
No effective MCP binding exists in this runtime path.

unresolved: Whether the third-party gitingest/Tavily clients themselves impose destination restrictions beyond the source-visible arguments.
